quarterly_data.signal: Partner Altarea: Altarea and Vantage signed a partnership to develop an AI and cloud data center campus on Altarea-owned land near Bordeaux, France, expected to be one of the largest in France; Altarea has already secured a 400MW power connection with the French utility. It is Vantage's first expansion into France.
